description: Tool to retrieve configured meeting location information for a given Calendly user. Use when you need to see all available location options configured by a user for their meetings.

inputSchema.description: Request model for listing configured meeting locations for a user.

user.description: URI of the user whose locations to list. This should be the full Calendly user URI (e.g., 'https://api.calendly.com/users/AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA').
user.title: User

inputSchema.title: ListUserLocationsRequest

name: list_user_locations

ListUserLocationsResponse.description: Response model containing a collection of user locations.

collection.description: Array of location resource objects configured for the user.
collection.title: Collection

ListUserLocationsResponse.title: ListUserLocationsResponse

LocationResource.description: Location resource object containing location configuration details.

additional_info.description: Additional details or instructions for the location.
additional_info.title: Additional Info

connected.description: Indicates whether the conferencing integration is connected (applicable for conference types).
connected.title: Connected

created_at.description: Timestamp when the location was created (ISO 8601 format in UTC).
created_at.title: Created At

location.description: The actual location value (address for physical, phone number for calls, or meeting URL).
location.title: Location

phone_number.description: Phone number for phone call locations.
phone_number.title: Phone Number

status.description: Current status of the location configuration (e.g., 'active', 'inactive').
status.title: Status

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the location was last updated (ISO 8601 format in UTC).
updated_at.title: Updated At

uri.description: Canonical reference (unique identifier) for the location.
uri.title: Uri

LocationResource.title: LocationResource
